note: intendedReleaseDate is the default / current ship date for release mode. Each page may set its own intendedReleaseDate; omitted pages use the top-level value. Consistency checks dateModified, visible 'Updated:' (where visibleUpdated) and sitemap lastmod against that page's declared date. Nicki confirms release dates. Before release set status to CONFIRMED and confirmedBy, then run: npm run release-gate (uses today Europe/Copenhagen) or npm run release-gate -- --ship-date=YYYY-MM-DD. Unrelated historical dates are out of scope.
